subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Chloro(porphyrinato)iron(III)（Fe(por)Cl）？
A. Square pyramidal
B. Trigonal bipyramidal
C. Trigonal planar
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Square pyramidal. Covalent count: Fe (group 8) 8 e; 1 × por (L₂X₂) 6 e; 1 × Cl (X) 1 e: 15 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −3 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Fe(III), d⁵; d⁵ + 10 e from the ligands = 15 e. The core of hemin; the porphyrin dianion is L2X2.
